evidence_reviewed: Timed sequence scaled kit fair test individual evidence and fallback
defects_found: Generic nine-kit assumption conflicted with pair allocation; physical handoff not proven
corrective_action_taken: Used conservative 13-kit allocation and retained local counted-kit/pretest gate
remaining_exception: Actual kit location count accommodations and substitute trial remain required
exception_justification: A repository review cannot inspect the school or observe a substitute

evidence_reviewed: Oral/picture modeling pointing dictation manipulation and evidence routes
corrective_action_taken: Rebuilt K pathways around modeled oral directions and nonwritten evidence options
remaining_exception: Student-specific communication sensory motor and language supports remain required
exception_justification: Individual needs cannot be inferred from files

evidence_reviewed: Technology classification named fallbacks and deferred execution evidence
defects_found: Legacy device dependence and risk of claiming hardware mastery from paper
corrective_action_taken: Added no-device routes and explicit limits on what those routes evidence
remaining_exception: Required programming robot or sensor execution must be rescheduled
exception_justification: An unplugged alternative cannot prove actual device operation

evidence_reviewed: Indoor routes model/supplied-data labels growth care and cleanup
defects_found: Outdoor and seasonal assumptions in legacy activities
corrective_action_taken: Added indoor routes and prohibited model data from being reported as live observation
remaining_exception: Room conditions plant care and actual closure calendar remain required
exception_justification: Local weather facilities and calendar are not repository facts

evidence_reviewed: 10/15/20/25 quantities team roles station/wave plans and individual evidence
defects_found: Serial queues and generic team counts did not always fit 25
corrective_action_taken: Added scalable allocations bounded teams and concurrent/rotation plans
remaining_exception: Room capacity supervision processing and actual stock remain required
exception_justification: Calculated capacity is not observed classroom feasibility

evidence_reviewed: Low-tech core reusable stock annual estimates and optional technology separation
defects_found: Specialty tools and unverified holdings could be mistaken for core requirements
corrective_action_taken: Separated low-tech core optional enhancements and reported holdings
remaining_exception: Current quotations stock count lead times and recurring cost remain required
exception_justification: Planning estimates are not purchase quotes

evidence_reviewed: Skills standards Catholic purpose progression projects and evidence language
defects_found: Legacy descriptions emphasized activities/devices over learning progression
corrective_action_taken: Added local competencies progression traceability and reusable family copy
remaining_exception: Actual child outcomes must come from teacher records not program promises
exception_justification: Planned curriculum cannot establish an individual student's mastery
